item.title: Traffic crash closes Hyannis intersection
item.description: HYANNIS – A traffic crash at North Street and Bassett Lane shutdown the intersection for a time. The collision happened about 2:15 PM Tuesday. Rescuers evaluated two people at the scene. Barnstable Police directed traffic around the scene and were investigating the cause of the crash. item.title: Tatiana Schlossberg, a grandchild of the late President John F. Kennedy, has died at 35
item.description: HYANNIS – Environmental journalist Tatiana Schlossberg, one of three grandchildren of the late President John F. Kennedy, has died after she was diagnosed with leukemia last year.
